item.title: Insensitivity of the North Pacific oxygen-deficient zone to recent ice age cycle climate changes
item.content:encoded:
Nature Geoscience, Published online: 19 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41561-026-02143-6

The intensity of the Pacific oxygen-deficient zones did not vary with global climate through glacial–interglacial cycles, indicating stabilizing feedbacks or offsetting effects, according to foraminifera-bound nitrogen isotope records.

item.title: Methane outburst driven by magma–sediment interactions at Fentale Volcano detected by satellite
item.content:encoded:
Nature Geoscience, Published online: 19 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41561-026-02137-4

Satellite detections of methane and carbon dioxide from the non-erupting Fentale Volcano, Ethiopia, coincide with dyke intrusion and localized ground subsidence, suggesting that unrest disrupted an accumulated gas reservoir, derived from underlying hydrocarbon-rich sediment.
item.dc:title: Methane outburst driven by magma–sediment interactions at Fentale Volcano detected by satellite
